direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just taken her phone back and thanked Kasun. He puts her at ease.
direction.people: Kasun stands at frame right facing left, in a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. His hands are empty at his sides, and he carries an easy, helpful warmth. Anudi is off screen.

flow.text: Kasun looks toward Anudi with a small, unforced smile.

flow.how: Gently matter-of-fact, reassuring her with a slight incline of his head

flow.text: His lips settle and he keeps his gaze on her, leaving room for her response.

direction.camera: Eye-level medium close-up toward frame right from the road side, 65mm lens, steady frame on a tripod, with the food three-wheeler in the right background.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
